explication: Umbriel is a Wayland compositor. Its principal workflow is to start a compositor backend, accept client and input events, manage windows in per-output workspaces and layouts, then present the resulting scene on configured outputs. The graph also covers documented configuration, effects, IPC, overview, locking, and Xwayland capabilities. Some links reflect documented capabilities or source-index imports rather than inspected call sites; unsampled implementation details are not asserted.
